components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Saffron action with ink text and a visible keyboard focus ring.
components.css: .ds-primary-button { padding: 12px 28px; border: 1px solid #6b5b38; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffb010; color: #2b251a; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(150, 98, 0, 0.18); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', '888box Gen Jyuu Gothic', sans-serif; font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 200ms ease; } .ds-primary-button:hover { background: #f2a600; color: #2b251a; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-primary-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #17324d; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Cream surface, navy text, and a quiet outline for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-secondary-button { padding: 12px 28px; border: 1px solid #17324d; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff9e8; color: #17324d; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', '888box Gen Jyuu Gothic', sans-serif; font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 200ms ease; } .ds-secondary-button:hover { background: #fff2d1; color: #2b251a; border-color: #17324d; } .ds-secondary-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #17324d; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Metadata Text Field
components.description: Representative video/audio batch field using its existing 6px radius.
components.css: .ds-text-field { width: 100%; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #6b5b38; border-radius: 6px; background: #fffefa; color: #2b251a; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', '888box Gen Jyuu Gothic', sans-serif; } .ds-text-field::placeholder { color: #655a43; opacity: 1; } .ds-text-field:focus-visible { border-color: #17324d; outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(23, 50, 77, 0.18); }

components.name: Section Navigation
components.description: Navy section rail with cream links and a saffron active tab.
components.html: ImagesVideo
components.css: .ds-section-rail { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid #17324d; border-radius: 12px; background: #17324d; } .ds-section-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; color: #fff9e8; text-decoration: none; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', '888box Gen Jyuu Gothic', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; transition: all 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-section-link:hover { color: #2b251a; background: #fff2d1; border-color: #ffb010; } .ds-section-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffb010; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-section-link-active { color: #2b251a; background: #ffb010; border-color: #ffb010; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Portal Asset Card
components.description: Warm-cream destination card that keeps the existing portal card geometry.
components.css: .ds-asset-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 220px; padding: 30px; border: 1px solid #9b8350; border-radius: 32px; background: #fff9e8; color: #2b251a; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(79, 58, 14, 0.10); transition: all 400ms cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275); } .ds-asset-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px) scale(1.02); } .ds-asset-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #17324d; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Purple Status Chip
components.description: The purple asset/status pair with an explicit label.
components.css: .ds-purple-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #6b21a8; border-radius: 6px; background: #f3e8ff; color: #6b21a8; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', '888box Gen Jyuu Gothic', sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Portal Masthead
components.description: Full-width saffron masthead that anchors the portal first view.
components.css: .ds-portal-masthead { width: calc(100% + 40px); margin: -40px -20px 36px; padding: 30px 20px 26px; border-bottom: 3px solid #17324d; background: #ffb010; color: #2b251a; text-align: center; } .ds-portal-masthead strong { display: block; color: #17324d; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', '888box Gen Jyuu Gothic', sans-serif; font-size: 2.7rem; font-weight: 900; } .ds-portal-masthead span { color: #2b251a; }

components.name: Portal Asset-Type Icons
components.description: Four 52px icon tiles using the image, video, file, and audio semantic color pairs.
components.css: .ds-asset-icon-set { display: flex; gap: 12px; } .ds-asset-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 52px; height: 52px; border: 1px solid #9b8350; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff2d1; color: #17324d; box-shadow: none; transition: all 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-asset-icon svg { width: 26px; height: 26px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-asset-icon-image { color: #075985; background: #e0f2fe; border-color: #075985; } .ds-asset-icon-video { color: #6b21a8; background: #f3e8ff; border-color: #6b21a8; } .ds-asset-icon-file { color: #166534; background: #dcfce7; border-color: #166534; } .ds-asset-icon-audio { color: #92400e; background: #fef3c7; border-color: #92400e; } .ds-asset-icon-set:hover .ds-asset-icon { transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.08); box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(79, 58, 14, 0.12); }

narrative.overview:
888 BOX is an operational asset desk for four asset types. The portal puts a universal upload surface and the image, video, file, and audio centers in the first view; routed centers, administration, and shared asset pages retain their established task layouts. Saffron marks primary actions and the current section, navy carries headings, links, and section navigation, and clay identifies upload targets.

Warm cream panels sit on a warm canvas with ink copy and muted supporting text. The shared UI uses the system sans stack declared in `static/css/fonts.css`. Global theme rules carry the paper surfaces, shared navigation, semantic state pairs, and focus treatment across the updated routes while local page CSS supplies each task's spacing and geometry.
keyCharacteristics: Warm canvas, cream panels, and dark ink text.
Saffron mastheads and primary actions; navy hierarchy, links, and section navigation.
Four asset centers with route-specific upload, management, and share layouts.
Explicit foreground/background pairs for semantic messages, asset-type chips, and portal center icons.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Saffron Rule
rules.body: Primary actions and the active section tab use ink on saffron; hover shifts the fill to saffron-hover.

rules.name: The Paired-State Rule
rules.body: Keep each semantic foreground with its matching background and label the state in text or an icon.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Meet WCAG 2.2 AA: normal text needs at least 4.5:1 contrast, large text needs at least 3:1 under SC 1.4.3, and essential control indicators need at least 3:1 against adjacent colors under SC 1.4.11.

rules.name: The UI-Stack Rule
rules.body: Keep the declared system UI stack for interface text; the variable-font specimen in the direction contract is not the shipped UI font.

dos: Do use ink on saffron for primary actions and the active section tab.
Do keep links navy on warm surfaces and use the defined semantic foreground/background pairs.
Do preserve existing page layouts and the responsive section navigation.
Do meet WCAG 2.2 AA text and non-text contrast thresholds.
Do use the specified semantic pairs for asset-type icons and keep their text titles visible.
donts: Don't use color alone to communicate upload, warning, error, or asset-type state.
Don't replace the shared system UI stack or introduce a radius or shadow without checking the route CSS.
Don't reintroduce obsolete dark-theme accents into shared controls or surfaces.
